brandSources.note: Copied from the audit site's own CSS tokens: --paper #faf6ef, --card #fffdf8, --ink #23201b, --line #e5dcc9. The story is the audit's own presentation, so it wears the audit site's paper-and-ink identity exactly.
The site's own muted tone, kept as-is: it clears 4.5:1 on the paper background (about 5.2:1).
The site's signature brick red — its headline and finding accents. About 7.8:1 on the paper background. Used as the accent and as the Findings cluster colour.

The site's second colour is literally named 'press' — the blue of its links and evidence furniture. Used for the Promise cluster (the claim, in print). The remaining cluster colours are neighbours built inside the site's red/blue/ink family: a teal neighbour of press blue for the method, a darkened tan from the site's line colour family for the pattern, a violet neighbour of press blue for the vendor, a deep green for the control cluster (the one cluster whose subject is a pass), and the deep cyan Claim Checker uses for its own audit cluster in the Ground News story, kept so the two dogfood stories share one audit colour. Each clears 3:1 on #faf6ef.

The site body type is the ui-sans-serif / system-ui stack (probe: ui-sans-serif ×4 uses; Georgia appears once, for display). The theme uses the same system stack; no webfont, so the page reads identically offline.
No logo is embedded. The wordmark is the audit's own name in plain text, as the audit site presents it.

font.body: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif

name: Operation Front Door — the audit site's paper, ink and press blue
